result.title: Structured Channel Network Pruning with Bi-Sparse Matrix Factorization
result.summary: Structured channel pruning for convolutional neural networks (CNNs) plays an important role in pattern recognition and deep learning. Nevertheless, existing methods usually calculate channel importance scores based on the magnitudes of individual filters, making it difficult to distinguish shared redundancy from individual channel contributions. To tackle this limitation, we propose a novel structured channel pruning method termed bi-sparse matrix factorization (BSMF). Specifically, BSMF characterizes the convolutional weight matrix as output-channel coefficients over a shared basis with row-wise $\ell_{2,p}$-norm and column-wise $\ell_{2,q}$-norm regularization terms, respectively. Note that $p,q\in[0,1)$, which, to our best knowledge, has not been explored in the literature. To solve the resulting non-convex optimization problem, we develop an efficient update scheme built upon the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM), in which all subproblems admit closed-form solutions. After that, a compact CNN is obtained by reconstructing the convolutional filters from the learned factors and discarding the redundant channels. Extensive experiments on the CIFAR-10 and ImageNet-1K datasets demonstrate that our proposed BSMF achieves significant network compression while maintaining high reconstruction accuracy. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/xianchaoxiu/BSMF

AI.brief_summary: 提出双稀疏矩阵分解（BSMF）的结构化通道剪枝方法，将卷积权重表示为共享基上的输出通道系数并施加行/列稀疏正则，用 ADMM 求解，在 CIFAR-10 与 ImageNet-1K 上实现压缩并保持精度。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作聚焦 CNN 通道剪枝与网络压缩，不涉及视觉推理状态、证据筛选、动态计算或 latent 表示的使用与监督，与 LVR 主线缺少实质联系，也未给出可借鉴的状态建模线索。
